notes.title: Time, Gears, and Gemstones: The Palace’s Quiet Lessons
notes.notes:
[p]Clockwork Palace is more than a puzzle sequence. Each level wants you to read analogue and digital clocks through the quiet mechanics of gears and gemstones.[/p][p][/p][p]At first, you align time dials – simple, satisfying precision.[/p][p]Soon, you calculate hidden time differences using ancient gems embedded in mechanical locks.[/p][p][/p][p]What begins as matching becomes an elegant exercise in clockwork thinking – revealing a palace built from time itself.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Clockwork Palace is available now in Early Access. Wishlist to step into this handcrafted Mughal steampunk world and shape its future chapters.[/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550006/c4477fc7afb4673edbf7d5c419b8df71e7a0dd81.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Meet the Clockwork Genie: Guardian of Forgotten Time
notes.notes:
[p]In Clockwork Palace, the Genie is your silent companion – a creation of brass filigree, turquoise alloys, and lost Mughal mechanica.[/p][p]They appear wherever time has ceased to move, gliding between chambers with a quiet presence.[/p][p][b]What is their purpose?[/b]
To whisper hints. Reveal hidden glyphs. Nudge your thoughts towards solutions only seen by those who think in gears and shadows.[/p][p]But their kindness is layered with secrets. This Genie has witnessed centuries of lost knowledge – and only those fluent in the Palace’s quiet language will understand their story.[/p][p]Clockwork Palace is now available in Early Access, with the Genie’s full journey unfolding in coming updates. Adding it to your Wishlist supports the expansion of this hand-crafted mughal steampunk world, one puzzle at a time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550006/c02865421baba19643af3133153b70f68fb81170.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Designing Clockwork Palace
notes.notes: [p]Clockwork Palace: Mysteries of the Mughal Mechanicum began with a simple design question:[/p][p][/p][p]What if telling time itself was a puzzle?[/p][p][/p][p]Each chamber of the Palace introduces time in its most tangible form – aligning analogue and digital clocks to unlock ancient Mughal doors and awaken long-silent gears.[/p][p][/p][p]As you progress deeper, these puzzles grow into layered mechanical challenges, weaving together:[/p][list][*][p]Mughal geometry[/p][/*][*][p]Steampunk machinery[/p][/*][*][p]Visual logic inspired by celestial observatories[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Why clocks?[/b][/p][p]Because clocks are living puzzles – hidden in plain sight. We wanted Clockwork Palace to feel both timeless and intimate, transforming something familiar into a quiet intellectual wonder.[/p][p][/p][p]Clockwork Palace is now live in Early Access, as we refine and expand this hand-crafted world. Adding it to your Wishlist supports its journey to full release and helps us share this artistic puzzle experience with more explorers.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550006/c02865421baba19643af3133153b70f68fb81170.png"][/img][/p]
